claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Finasteride is a non-cytotoxic 5-alpha reductase inhibitor that is not expected to kill cancer cells at 2.5 uM; any antiproliferative effect would be weak and mediated by androgen-pathway inhibition rather than direct cytotoxicity.
